title: Welcome

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: You seem lost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You seem lost.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Masato Shima. The fact you do not recognize me brings me great joy. It means I'm doing my job at the highest level of efficiency.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Masato Shima. The fact you do not recognize me brings me great joy. It means I'm doing my job at the highest level of efficiency.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Because when you run a criminal organization stealing the most valuable item in Nivalis, having a face for the feeds is not a benefit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because when you run a criminal organization stealing the most valuable item in Nivalis, having a face for the feeds is not a benefit.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: No.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Enough. If the scorpion has led you to me then an acquaintance to me you are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Enough. If the scorpion has led you to me then an acquaintance to me you are.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: I lead a group of entrepreneurs that specialize in negotiations, hostile takeovers, and most importantly, acquisitions of the most valuable item in Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I lead a group of entrepreneurs that specialize in negotiations, hostile takeovers, and most importantly, acquisitions of the most valuable item in Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: It means that you and I are acquainted of course. Almost to the point of friendliness. That will just depend on how you handle yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It means that you and I are acquainted of course. Almost to the point of friendliness. That will just depend on how you handle yourself.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Since you've made it thus far, found us--found me--and are engaged in this conversation, it's safe to say your curiosity has been piqued.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Since you've made it thus far, found us--found me--and are engaged in this conversation, it's safe to say your curiosity has been piqued.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: As it should have. The scorpions have been scurrying through Nivalis for decades now. I still remember the first chip. The gift it was to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As it should have. The scorpions have been scurrying through Nivalis for decades now. I still remember the first chip. The gift it was to me.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: It's a story that exists in a locked file on an unknown Nets drive. You have to get access to it first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a story that exists in a locked file on an unknown Nets drive. You have to get access to it first.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Our existence is a riddle. This would be but a single line in the lengthy collective question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Our existence is a riddle. This would be but a single line in the lengthy collective question.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Perform well. Become my friend. Friends share stories... and bonds until death.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perform well. Become my friend. Friends share stories... and bonds until death.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: If this locale upsets you, then you are not from this city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If this locale upsets you, then you are not from this city.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: I don't know you. Though, it would be a falsity to say that you don't intrigue me. I'm very interested in how you'll handle yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know you. Though, it would be a falsity to say that you don't intrigue me. I'm very interested in how you'll handle yourself.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: We are not close enough for you to make those. It takes a friend, someone dear, to allow your guard to drop so you can laugh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We are not close enough for you to make those. It takes a friend, someone dear, to allow your guard to drop so you can laugh.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: You close your eyes when you laugh. Or maybe you leave them open but tilt your head back and bellow to the sky.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You close your eyes when you laugh. Or maybe you leave them open but tilt your head back and bellow to the sky.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: It takes one quarter of a second, for someone standing idly in front of you to punch you in the face. If they have a knife against their wrist?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It takes one quarter of a second, for someone standing idly in front of you to punch you in the face. If they have a knife against their wrist?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: So there's a story there. One, undoubtedly, infused with intrigue. Or maybe just a blandness masquerading as something flavorful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So there's a story there. One, undoubtedly, infused with intrigue. Or maybe just a blandness masquerading as something flavorful.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Well, as you so eloquently put it, you are wandering around the sewers afterall...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, as you so eloquently put it, you are wandering around the sewers afterall...

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: You're still standing here, are you not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're still standing here, are you not?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: There is a person, a Mizzy Weiss, who owes me Lims. A lot of Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There is a person, a Mizzy Weiss, who owes me Lims. A lot of Lims.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: They borrowed what they could not pay back. Or rather, they lost what they needed to pay back. Gambling is a miserable vice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They borrowed what they could not pay back. Or rather, they lost what they needed to pay back. Gambling is a miserable vice.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: I do. And so do you. Because once those Lims are mine again, delivered by none other than yourself, another door will open for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do. And so do you. Because once those Lims are mine again, delivered by none other than yourself, another door will open for you.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: You know of them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know of them?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Time will tell you. That and your ability to handle this task. Be gone now. I look forward to your return.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Time will tell you. That and your ability to handle this task. Be gone now. I look forward to your return.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Masato Shima. While I'm thrilled you don't remember me, I'm also disappointed you don't recall our previous interactions. Says more about you than it does about the efficiency in which I do my job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Masato Shima. While I'm thrilled you don't remember me, I'm also disappointed you don't recall our previous interactions. Says more about you than it does about the efficiency in which I do my job.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Take a few seconds to feel humor. Is that what you're saying?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Take a few seconds to feel humor. Is that what you're saying?

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Serrated fake nails edged with poison? Your laughter--your seconds of joy--just ended your addiction to breathing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Serrated fake nails edged with poison? Your laughter--your seconds of joy--just ended your addiction to breathing.

nodes.speaker: Masato Shima
nodes.text: Naive, and no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Naive, and no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, I am wandering around the sewers so...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I am wandering around the sewers so...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Well, I am wandering around the sewers so...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Well, I am wandering around the sewers so...

nodes.text: (show coin) This brought me here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: (show coin) This brought me here.

nodes.text: Who are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's your job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's your job?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would you not want to be recognized?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would you not want to be recognized?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would you not want to be recognized?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would you not want to be recognized?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're running bootleg clean water?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're running bootleg clean water?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you're running bootleg clean water?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you're running bootleg clean water?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Clean air then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Clean air then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does that mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think I want to handle anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think I want to handle anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think I want to handle anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think I want to handle anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bring on whatever you got.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bring on whatever you got.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...handle myself doing what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...handle myself doing what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the story behind it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the story behind it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wasn't finding you enough of a riddle?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wasn't finding you enough of a riddle?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wasn't finding you enough of a riddle?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wasn't finding you enough of a riddle?

nodes.text: How do I do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do I do that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hey - sewers are where the best rats are. And you know me, love a good rat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey - sewers are where the best rats are. And you know me, love a good rat.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hey - sewers are where the best rats are. And you know me, love a good rat.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hey - sewers are where the best rats are. And you know me, love a good rat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It was a joke.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was a joke.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where I'm from doesn't matter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where I'm from doesn't matter.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't need to drop your guard to laugh.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't need to drop your guard to laugh.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don't need to drop your guard to laugh.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don't need to drop your guard to laugh.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Exactly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what's the next step?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what's the next step?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Eh, wouldn't be so sure about that.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: Eh, wouldn't be so sure about that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Eh, wouldn't be so sure about that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fair.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fair.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you want me to get it back for you?

nodes.text: Masato sends him on the quest and that's how the player finds out what the most valuable item is (thoughts/ideas) but only if he collects the money from the gambler

“We don’t value the necessities in ways that we should. We value what we value and there is no exception to that. If I were to ask people what their favourite thing in life is, not one person will say to me: water, air, nourishment. They’ll reply with something trivial, something tangible and inconsequential. Me? I am no different.”



“Of course you may take that. And if you do, I’ll gladly take your arm in return.”



“Holos are innocent. They are neither bad nor good nor do they involve others in their misguided efforts to get ahead. They simply exist.”
